DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSES OF MEASLES
Differential Diagnoses
- Rubella,
- Roseola infantum,
- Infections from Echovirus, Coxsackie Virus and Adenovirus
- Infectious mononucleosis
- Toxoplasmosis
- Meningococcaemia
- Drug rashes
Complications
- Diarrhoea,
- Otitis media

- Pneumonia
- Laryngo-tracheobronchitis
- Malnutrition
- Encephalitis
- flaccid paralysis
- Seizures or Blindness
- Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis
